suggested_fix: No fix required. Each per-device mode is checked for NULL before use, freed once (the mode's optional free callback runs first, then free_device_compression_mode), and the slot is set to NULL afterwards, so a later call cannot double-free it or use it after it is freed. As a defensive hardening, the code could also check that iaa_compression_modes[i] is non-NULL before dereferencing it, in case the global mode table and the per-device modes ever get out of sync.
